fixedPowertrain.source: Phase-9 fixed powertrain design; unchanged for this aerodynamic study

operatingPoint.inletTotalStateSource: ISA static state plus isentropic freestream compression at flight Mach
operatingPoint.outletStaticPressureSource: ISA freestream static pressure; no target total-pressure recovery imposed

geometry.branchOutlet: one semicircular annulus per slot branch, 90 mm OD / 32 mm ID; two branches form each EDF annulus
geometry.branchMassFlowSource: Phase-9 720 km/h meanline total divided by 2 ducts and 2 slots per duct

projectedAreaGate.method: Complete CAD projected silhouette including modeled structure; no extra allowance is added

mesh.method: Gmsh OpenCASCADE quarter-turn sweep of an exact 25x120 mm slot and smoothstep loft to the half-annulus outlet; linear tetrahedra; MSH2 physical inlet/outlet/walls

solver.recoverySource: Converged OpenFOAM solution p/U/T surface-field averages; reconstructed isentropic total pressure, never a target-recovery boundary value
